info.title: Cadmus HTTP API
info.description: REST translation of the Cadmus command protocol. Generated from @cadmus/contract. readOnly commands are GET and HEAD with query parameters; other commands are POST JSON. Authorization is a Bearer header. A token query parameter is rejected.

post.summary: Create a scheduled task (recurring cron, relative delay timer, or absolute timestamp) for a bot.

id.description: Optional custom identifier for the schedule. Generated if omitted.

anyOf.description: One-shot schedule based on relative duration strictly from now (e.g. '10s', '5m', '1s4m', '4s 2m', '100ms', or plain number in seconds).
One-shot schedule targeted at an absolute date and time (e.g. 'tomorrow at 5pm', ISO string '2026-10-18T22:30:00Z', or epoch timestamp).
Recurring schedule governed by a cron pattern expression or standard nickname (e.g. '0 9 * * *' or '@hourly').

input.description: Unified timing input interpreted according to kind: relative duration for 'relative' (e.g. '5s', '10m', 10), absolute date/time for 'absolute' (e.g. 'tomorrow at 5pm', ISO string, epoch ms), or cron pattern for 'cron' (e.g. '0 9 * * *', '@hourly').

text.description: Prompt text delivered to the bot when the schedule triggers.

enabled.description: Whether the schedule is initially active (defaults to true).

schema.description: Parameters for creating a scheduled task.

post.summary: Create a just-bash or local-daemon tools env definition. Daemon rows require confineToWorkspace. The workspace path is reported by the daemon process.

Delete a tools env definition and its env DO data.
Mint a 15-minute single-use pairing token for a local-daemon env.

Deregister a tools env. Every kind is removed the same way as delete: env state is wiped, the account row is dropped, and the account default is cleared when it pointed at this env. A local-daemon env first has its pairing revoked and any live connection closed.

members.description: Bot ids that belong to a group chat, in join order.

toolsReadOnly.description: When true, this group chat was opened with message_bot readOnly. Target members are offered only memory and knowledge read tools. Absent or false keeps each member's normal tools. The user still cannot post.

harvest.description: Per-chat idle harvest switch. Omitted means on. Group-chat sessions default to off.

groupStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a group chat.

turnMs.description: Resolved turn limit in milliseconds. 0 means no limit.

runMs.description: Resolved run limit in milliseconds. 0 means no limit.

deleted.description: Whether this chat has been soft-deleted.

deletedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the chat was soft-deleted.

originChatKey.description: Routing key of the originating chat that spawned this child or group member chat.

ChatRecord.description: Chat session record tracking a conversation thread with a specific bot, or a read-only group chat shared by bots.

ChatRenameResult.description: Result payload returned by chat.rename containing the renamed chat record.

reset.description: Always true, confirming the conversation transcript was reset.

ChatResetResult.description: Result payload returned by chat.reset confirming conversation history reset.

conversationId.description: Internal durable conversation sequence ID backing this chat.

botId.description: Identifier of the bot participating in this chat.

botName.description: Display name of the participating bot.

model.description: Active model identifier used for turns in this chat.

anyOf.description: List of permitted tool names or patterns.
All registered tools are permitted.

tools.description: Permitted tools for this chat. An array is the bot allowlist, and an empty array allows no gated tools. 'all' is the default when bot.tools is omitted.

busy.description: True if a model turn is currently in progress, false if idle.

entryCount.description: Total number of transcript entries recorded in this conversation.

harvestWatermark.description: Highest transcript entry sequence number harvested into long-term memory.

nextWakeAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds of the next scheduled alarm wake, or null if no alarm is pending.

done.description: Finished task count still on the chat.

ChatStatusRecord.description: Live runtime execution status, active model configuration, and alarm scheduling for a chat session.

ChatStatusResult.description: Live runtime status for a chat session.

index.description: Per-chat task index. Never reused after removal.

createdAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the task was created.

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the task last changed.

round.description: Auto-continue rounds since the last user message.

ChatTaskStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a chat task.

tasks.description: All tasks for the chat, including details.

anyOf.description: Static API key credential configuration.

refreshToken.description: Optional refresh token used to renew expired access tokens.

expiresAt.description: Optional epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the access token expires.

anyOf.description: OAuth access and refresh token configuration.

CredentialInput.description: Authentication credentials for an AI provider, supporting static API keys or refreshed OAuth tokens.

providerId.description: Unique identifier of the AI provider (e.g. 'anthropic', 'openai', 'google', 'groq', 'deepseek', 'xai').

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when this credential was stored or last refreshed.

CredentialSummary.description: Sanitized metadata summarizing a configured AI provider credential without revealing secret values.

turnMs.description: Limit for one turn in milliseconds. Omitted inherits the default. 0 means no limit. Values above 24 hours are rejected.

runMs.description: Limit for an autonomous run (task loop or group chat) in milliseconds. Omitted inherits the default. 0 means no limit. Values above 24 hours are rejected.

Deadlines.description: Per-chat deadline overrides. Omitted fields inherit defaults. 0 means no limit.

root.description: Runtime directory. Present for just-bash, and for a local-daemon only while that daemon is connected.

EffectiveToolsEnv.description: Resolved tools env definition used for a bot or chat.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable protocol error code. CAS conflicts use cas_conflict (HTTP 409). /api auth failures use unauthorized, query_token_not_allowed, or header_required (HTTP 401).

FamilyCreateResult.description: Result payload returned by family.create containing the newly registered family record.

deleted.description: Identifier of the bot family that was deleted.

FamilyDeleteResult.description: Result payload returned by family.delete confirming deletion of the bot family.

FamilyGetResult.description: Result payload returned by family.get, including teamLeaderBotId when a Team Leader is set.

families.description: List of bot families registered to the account.

FamilyListResult.description: Result payload returned by family.list. Each family includes teamLeaderBotId when a Team Leader is set.

accountId.description: Identifier of the owning tenant account.

familyId.description: Unique slug or identifier of the bot family within the account.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the bot family.

doName.description: Deterministic Cloudflare Durable Object instance name backing this family ('cadmus:{accountId}:{familyId}').

timezone.description: Default IANA timezone identifier for this family (e.g. 'America/Los_Angeles').

harvestDelayMs.description: Idle delay in milliseconds after conversation activity before running background memory/knowledge harvesting.

teamLeaderBotId.description: Bot id of this family's Team Leader. Omitted when no Team Leader is set.

createdAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the family was created.

FamilyRecord.description: Bot family metadata representing a partitioned Durable Object runtime instance, including the optional Team Leader bot id.

FamilyUpdateResult.description: Result payload returned by family.update, including teamLeaderBotId when a Team Leader is set.

deleted.description: Virtual workspace file path that was deleted.

FileDeleteResult.description: Result payload returned by file.delete confirming deletion of the file.

anyOf.description: Bot system prompt / personality instructions file.
Bot long-term memory file.
Topic-specific knowledge base document.

version.description: Version sequence number for optimistic concurrency control (CAS).

files.description: List of virtual workspace files (SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, knowledge documents).

text.description: Text content of the file (alias for content).

version.description: Current version sequence number for optimistic concurrency control.

body.description: Document markdown body without header metadata (for knowledge documents).

deleted.description: Virtual file path that was deleted.

anyOf.description: Confirmation of file deletion.

path.description: Virtual workspace file path that was written.

diff.description: Unified diff representation showing modifications applied to the file.

chatKey.description: Routing key of the chat session whose conversation was harvested.

at.description: Conversation entry sequence number / watermark up to which harvest was performed.

files.description: List of files modified during harvest with their unified diffs.

when.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the harvest execution occurred.

HarvestNote.description: Audit note recording knowledge and memory extractions completed by background idle harvest tasks.

version.description: Current version sequence number of the document.

snippet.description: Matching text excerpt from the document body or description.

KnowledgeSearchResult.description: Individual knowledge document search match with snippet excerpt.

results.description: List of matching knowledge document excerpts.

KnowledgeSearchResults.description: Result payload returned by knowledge.search containing search matches.

provider.description: Identifier of the provider hosting the model (e.g. 'anthropic', 'openai').

name.description: Human-readable display name of the model.

contextWindow.description: Maximum context window size in tokens, if known.

maxTokens.description: Maximum completion / generation token limit supported, if known.

reasoning.description: True if the model supports extended reasoning / thinking tokens.

thinkingLevels.description: List of discrete thinking levels supported by this model.

authenticated.description: True if valid credentials currently exist to invoke this model.

credentialConfigured.description: True if an account-level or environment credential has been configured for the model's provider.

flowId.description: Unique identifier for this OAuth flow session.

providerId.description: Identifier of the provider being authenticated.

anyOf.description: Flow is waiting for the user to navigate to verification URL.
Flow is awaiting interactive user input described by the prompt field.
Authorization is actively polling or exchanging credentials.
Authentication completed successfully; credentials have been saved.
Authentication encountered an error and terminated.
Authentication was explicitly cancelled by the client.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the OAuth flow.

userCode.description: User verification code to display for device authorization flows.

verificationUri.description: Target URL where the user must navigate to approve the authorization.

verificationUriComplete.description: Pre-authenticated URL that automatically embeds the userCode for one-click approval.

authorizationUrl.description: Browser authorization URL used in browser-based redirect flows.

intervalSeconds.description: Recommended polling interval in seconds for device code status checking.

expiresAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when this authorization flow will expire.

message.description: Human-readable status or guidance message intended for display.

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when this flow record was last updated.

anyOf.description: Single-line plain text prompt.
Masked confidential input prompt (e.g. password or secret).
Selection list prompt requiring the user to choose an option.
Manual authorization code entry copied from an external browser window.

message.description: Human-readable prompt instruction displayed to the user.

placeholder.description: Optional input placeholder text for client UI display.

id.description: Unique value identifier for this option choice.

label.description: Human-readable label for this option choice.

description.description: Optional secondary description for the option.

options.description: Array of selectable choices when prompt type is 'select'.

providerId.description: Unique identifier of the AI provider (e.g. 'anthropic', 'openai', 'github').

name.description: Human-readable display name of the provider.

anyOf.description: RFC 8628 OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant (user navigates to URL and enters code).
Browser redirection flow with authorization code exchange.
Multi-step interactive CLI prompt flow driven by server-sent prompts.

loginLabel.description: Optional button or action label for starting authentication (e.g. 'Log in with Claude Pro/Max').

isSubscription.description: True if authentication links an active model subscription rather than token billing.

code.description: Machine-readable error code identifying the failure category (e.g. 'invalid_command', 'not_found', 'unauthorized', 'conflict').

message.description: Human-readable explanation of why the command failed or could not be processed.

ProtocolError.description: Standard protocol error details included in rejected command results or error events.

model.description: Underlying pi-ai model messages with inner content blocks.

byTaskId.description: Task ID that appended this entry.

ScheduleCreateResult.description: Result payload returned by schedule.create containing the newly registered schedule record.

deleted.description: Identifier of the schedule that was deleted.

ScheduleDeleteResult.description: Result payload returned by schedule.delete confirming deletion of the schedule.

ScheduleListResult.description: Result payload returned by schedule.list containing scheduled tasks.

botId.description: Identifier of the bot executing the scheduled prompt.

name.description: Optional human-readable label or description for the schedule.

anyOf.description: One-shot schedule based on relative duration strictly from now (e.g. '10s', '5m', '1s4m', '4s 2m', '100ms', or plain number in seconds).
One-shot schedule targeted at an absolute date and time (e.g. 'tomorrow at 5pm', ISO string '2026-10-18T22:30:00Z', or epoch timestamp).
Recurring schedule governed by a cron pattern expression or standard nickname (e.g. '0 9 * * *' or '@hourly').

kind.description: Schedule timing mechanism: 'relative' for relative delay from now, 'absolute' for absolute date and time, or 'cron' for recurring cron jobs.

input.description: Unified timing expression interpreted according to kind: relative duration for 'relative' (e.g. '5s', '10m', 10), absolute date/time for 'absolute' (e.g. 'tomorrow at 5pm', ISO string, epoch ms), or cron expression for 'cron' (e.g. '0 9 * * *', '@hourly').

nextRun.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the schedule will next execute.

inSeconds.description: Remaining relative time from now until nextRun execution in seconds, reported for convenience regardless of scheduling method.

recurring.description: Whether the schedule repeats periodically (true for recurring cron schedules, false for one-shot relative or absolute timers).

text.description: Prompt text delivered to the bot when the schedule triggers.

enabled.description: Whether the schedule is active. Disabled schedules are skipped during alarm checks.

internal.description: True if this schedule was generated internally by the system (e.g. idle harvest timer).

ScheduleRecord.description: Scheduled task record defining execution cadence, target chat mode, prompt, and next run timestamp.

mode.description: Deliver the scheduled prompt to an existing chat session.

anyOf.description: Target an existing persistent chat session.

mode.description: Create a brand new chat session for each scheduled trigger.

harvest.description: True if this fork is an internal idle harvest task inspecting conversation history.

anyOf.description: Fork an existing chat at a specific watermark, typically for background memory/knowledge harvesting.

ScheduleUpdateResult.description: Result payload returned by schedule.update containing updated schedule settings.
